content.thinking:
So numpy requires LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native. The runner sets it, so it will work in production. For my local testing I'll set it.

Now let me test inference speed: 512 windows one at a time.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native python3 -c "
import sys, time, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import numpy as np
random.seed(1)
feats=[[[random.randint(0,1500), random.randint(0,2560)] for _ in range(9)] for _ in range(512)]
labels=[0]*512
arr=np.asarray(feats,dtype=np.int64)
import testcnnonnx, testrnnonnx
t=time.time(); p1=testcnnonnx.evaluate_model_single_pass(arr,labels); print('cnn 512 one-shot call', time.time()-t, p1[:8])
t=time.time(); p2=testrnnonnx.evaluate_model_single_pass(arr,labels); print('rnn 512 one-shot call', time.time()-t, p2[:8])
"
